verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published TFLOPS or TOPS figures with precision or sparsity stated. The only performance claim is the relative marketing figure "Up to 2.2X the AI performance vs. competitive accelerators", which is exactly the bare number the story rejects. Datatype support (MXFP6/MXFP4) and community discussion of relative per-clock throughput do not amount to per-precision peak tensor throughput an engineer could size workloads from. The vendor product page was also unreachable to the crawler, so a spec table may exist that the pack does not capture.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
